name: Heaven Strada
source:
Aleph grew up listening about rare artifacts and adventures in the ancient ruins. As he becomes adult, he joins his uncle who got position of ruins caretaker.

When he comes to the duel place in the ruins with his childhood friend, Aleph meets a girl in unfamiliar clothes being attacked by inquisition men in black. As enemies are defeated, Aleph takes girl home. She tells that she comes from the world of the blue sky. They decide to guard the ruins together against the men in black and work towards getting to the world of the blue sky.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿莱夫从小听着稀有遗物和古代遗迹冒险的故事长大。成年后，他投奔获得遗迹管理员职位的叔叔。

一天，阿莱夫与青梅竹马来到遗迹里的决斗场，遇见一名身穿陌生服饰、正遭黑衣审判官袭击的少女。击退敌人后，阿莱夫把她带回家。少女说自己来自蓝天世界。两人决定共同守护遗迹，抵御黑衣人，并设法前往蓝天世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
